title: Luminous Leaves

scene_beats.setting: Portal opens onto towering trees with glowing leaves. Light falls in green-gold flakes.
scene_beats.action: The Tattered Traveler steps through first, then Arin and the beasts.

scene_beats.setting: Village fields below the trees. Crops gray and bent, sky darkening like a smudge spreading.
scene_beats.action: Withering crops (Stills). Villagers stare at the sky.

scene_beats.setting: Edge of the forest. A glowcap patch shines under the roots, the only bright thing near the fields.
scene_beats.action: The Traveler hands Arin a glowcap and points to the biggest house.

zeref_moment: Zeref bats a glowing leaf. It sticks to his beanie.

title: Elder Thorne

scene_beats.setting: Thorne's house: low beams, warm hearth, carved tablets on shelves. A big chair by the fire.
scene_beats.action: Elder Thorne, sturdy and gray, rises to greet them. He coughs.

dialogue.speaker: Elder Thorne
text_lines: Old men cough. It is a

scene_beats.setting: Corner of the room. Sethra at the window, mending a net, eyes on her father the whole time.
scene_beats.action: Sethra pretends she is not watching. She is watching.

scene_beats.setting: Hearth close-up. Thorne hands Arin a poultice wrapped in leaves, hands steady, voice not.
scene_beats.action: Thorne tells the curse: it started at the old altar in the woods.

zeref_moment: Zeref claims Thorne's chair. Thorne lets him. Remember this.

title: Supplies at Dawn

scene_beats.setting: Eldoria at dawn. Mist on gray fields, birds silent. A rope coil and herb baskets by the door.
scene_beats.action: Gather healing herbs and rope before setting out.

scene_beats.setting: Thorne holds Arin's lantern up to a crystal on his shelf. Light pours in, clean and white-blue.
scene_beats.action: Thorne infuses the lantern: the Crystal Lantern. A big Light upgrade.

scene_beats.setting: Village gate. Sethra and Thorne side by side, small against the dark trees.
scene_beats.action: Sethra waves. Thorne coughs, then waves harder to hide it.

zeref_moment: Zeref stares into the new lantern. Stars swirl back at him.

title: The Forgotten

scene_beats.setting: Ruins in the Whispering Woods. Two great statues with vines, eyes carved shut. Murals pulse blue.
scene_beats.action: The statues speak in one voice. A dialogue choice; every honest one works.

scene_beats.setting: Old altar in a sunken ring of stone. A wraith with dark grasping tendrils, fed on fear for centuries.
scene_beats.action: The Forgotten rises. Low Light makes it hit harder.

dialogue.speaker: Arin
text_lines: I believe in the power of

scene_beats.setting: A glowing crystal rises from the altar. Its beam punches through the ruins into the sky.
scene_beats.action: The land blooms. The Guardians of Eldoria wake and thank them.

rooms.description: Statue gate, carved murals pulse faint blue.
rooms.puzzle: Answer the statues honestly; then walk the safe mural lane.

rooms.description: Collapsed hall, trap floors under moss.
rooms.puzzle: Crystal Lantern reveals the true floor; fake tiles drop.

rooms.description: Fear corridor: whispers make shadows longer.
rooms.puzzle: Keep Light above half or tendrils double.

rooms.description: The old altar in a sunken stone ring.

boss.name: The Forgotten
boss.mechanic: Your fear makes it stronger: low Light means it hits harder. Keep Light up; finish with the Crystal Lantern beam.

idle_animation.description: Ragged wraith sways over the altar, tendrils curling like smoke ink.

phases.transformation: A wraith twice Arin's height, a face that is mostly hollow.

attacks.name: Fear Whisper
attacks.telegraph: Text goes gray, it leans in

phases.transformation: It feeds: swells to fill the altar ring, tendrils climb every pillar.

attacks.name: Nightmare Bloom
attacks.telegraph: Body opens like a dark flower

phases.transformation: A dark storm the size of the ruins, a thousand faces of old fears in it.

attacks.name: Centuries of Fear
attacks.effect: Wave of tendrils fills the floor

animation.description: Faces, scream, wave, wave, wave, recede

attacks.name: Eclipse
attacks.effect: Lantern dims; hold beam to answer

defeat_animation.description: Lantern beam pierces it, faces fade one by one, smoke unravels, altar glows, crystal rises, birds.

boss.canon: bible boss #10 (Whispering Woods ruins, Act IV, Heart 5,500, 3 phases; fear-fed wraith; finisher Crystal Lantern beam)

zeref_moment: Zeref puffs up at a wraith 100 times his size. Wins.

title: But Not Him

scene_beats.setting: Eldoria fields, green again. Wheat sways gold. Children run between rows.
scene_beats.action: The village celebrates. Arin runs to Thorne's house.

scene_beats.setting: Thorne's house, same chair, same hearth. Thorne smaller in it now. He coughs and does not stop.
scene_beats.action: The curse is gone. Thorne is still sick.

dialogue.speaker: Elder Thorne
text_lines: I am just old. And tired.

scene_beats.setting: Window at dusk. Sethra and Arin outside. A crocus in a cup on the sill, half open.
scene_beats.action: Sethra tells of a Tree of Mercy and its Oil. Thorne says no. She goes anyway.

dialogue.speaker: Sethra
text_lines: A Tree of Mercy. Its oil

dialogue.speaker: Elder Thorne
text_lines: I do not want it, Sethra.

zeref_moment: Zeref leaves the party to sit by Thorne's feet. Quietly.

title: Silent Gales
location: Forest of Whispers, the Silent Gale Pool

scene_beats.setting: Forest of Whispers. Mischievous spirits swap map markers; trees lean in like they're listening.
scene_beats.action: The Guardians of Eldoria give Arin a carved wooden box with a poem.

scene_beats.setting: A quiet pool at the forest edge, flat as glass. Reeds drawn in single pencil strokes.
scene_beats.action: Sit Down by the pool. Wait. Do nothing.

scene_beats.setting: Wind ripples the pool. In the reflection, a path of glowing stones leads into the trees.
scene_beats.action: The hidden path is only in the reflection. Walk it by watching the water.

zeref_moment: Zeref sleeps through the riddle. Wakes up at the answer.

title: Hollow Grove

scene_beats.setting: Stone door in a hill. Inside, a cavern lit by blue-green mushrooms; stepping stones cross a dark lake.
scene_beats.action: Arin crosses stone by stone. The water is deep and black.

dialogue.speaker: Sethra
text_lines: I do not know. Just do

scene_beats.setting: Middle of the lake. A mischievous spirit circles, made of glowcap light and giggles.
scene_beats.action: The spirit asks its riddle. A frog on a stone watches.

scene_beats.setting: Far shore pedestal of root and stone. The Crystal of Earth glows; a line of light points onward.
scene_beats.action: The spirit gives the crystal. The frog gives Zeref a leaf hat.

rooms.description: Stone door hall, mushroom light flickers.
rooms.puzzle: Light mushrooms in pairs to open the door.
Stones sink when a spirit giggles; step on the quiet ones.
Riddle room: Point at a promise (two linked hands mural).

boss.name: The Mischievous Spirit (Riddle of the Hollow Grove)
boss.mechanic: Mostly a riddle. Wrong answers make it split into tricks; Point at the promise mural to answer.

idle_animation.description: Ball of glowcap light bobs and giggles, little arms waving.

phases.transformation: A giggling light the size of a lantern.

attacks.name: Marker Swap
attacks.effect: Swaps your map marker; path hides

attacks.name: Splash Trick
attacks.effect: Splash knocks you off a stone

phases.transformation: It splits into a dozen lights over the whole lake, all giggling.

attacks.name: Which One?
attacks.effect: Find the real spirit by its echo

defeat_animation.description: Lights merge, it sighs, bows, the crystal floats to the pedestal.

boss.canon: bible 4.11 mischievous spirit riddle; riddle encounter, not a bible numbered boss
boss.sprite_note: Small sprite; Act II scale-down on purpose (a riddle, not a fight).

zeref_moment: Zeref wears the frog's leaf hat over his beanie. Two hats.

title: Bramble Warden

scene_beats.setting: Hollow Grove depths. Thorn walls, roots like grasping fingers, one huge shape weeping sap.
scene_beats.action: The Bramble Warden, a forest guardian twisted by despair, blocks the way.

dialogue.speaker: Bramble Warden
text_lines: Go back. There is no way

scene_beats.setting: Same depths, Crystal Lantern light reveals a mossy green guardian under the black thorns.
scene_beats.action: Light reveals its true form. Attune: speak to it.

dialogue.speaker: Arin
text_lines: I can help you find your

scene_beats.setting: Underbrush clearing. Twisted shadow creatures pour in; Warden and Arin stand back to back.
scene_beats.action: Wave fight beside the Warden. Win with a combined 'unleash' combo.

rooms.description: Thorn wall tunnel, roots grab at heels.
rooms.puzzle: Burn thorn walls with lantern beam; roots regrow in 5 sec.

rooms.description: Despair hollow; flowers here all droop.
rooms.puzzle: Lift each drooped flower with Mote's Glow to open roots.

rooms.description: Shadows in the Underbrush: arena clearing.
rooms.puzzle: Wave fight with the Warden; fill the unleash meter together.

boss.name: The Bramble Warden
boss.mechanic: Thorn walls and root grabs. Light reveals its true form; Attune with the line to purify it. It then fights beside you.

idle_animation.description: Huge thorn body hunches, shoulders shaking with slow sobs, sap drips.

phases.transformation: A thorn guardian three times Arin's height, face hidden by brambles.
It roots into the grove; the whole thicket becomes its body.
Thorns fall away in the light: a towering green guardian, crying, half free.

attacks.name: Last Thorns
attacks.effect: Final thorn rain; hold lantern up

defeat_animation.description: Last thorns drop, moss blooms green, it kneels, cries leaves, stands beside you.

boss.defeat_line: I lost my way. Not now.
boss.canon: bible boss #11 (Hollow Grove, Act IV, Heart 6,000, 3 phases, Attunable: 'I can help you find your way back'); then joins for bible 4.13 wave

zeref_moment: Zeref rides on the Warden's head into the wave fight.

title: Stilled Serpent

scene_beats.setting: Road to the Garden, deep forest. A serpent of gray stillness coils across the path, eyes like coins.
scene_beats.action: The Stilled Serpent strikes and bites Sethra.

scene_beats.setting: Same road, the bite spreading gray up Sethra's arm. The serpent talks in a soft human voice.
scene_beats.action: It rubs in her family's old mistakes. Arin fights phase 1.

scene_beats.setting: Same road. Sethra stands, chin up. Player now controls Sethra; command words glow.
scene_beats.action: Sethra, not Arin, ends it. She commands it silent. The wound fades.

rooms.description: Forest road; whispering spirits swap your markers.
rooms.puzzle: Follow the Crystal of Earth's light line, not the map markers.

rooms.description: Sunken road, stilled puddles like gray glass.
rooms.puzzle: Puddles freeze you on touch; hop the ones that ripple.

rooms.description: Fallen tree crossing, the serpent's nest.

boss.name: The Stilled Serpent
boss.mechanic: Bites, poisons, speaks in a human voice. Phase 2: control Sethra; pick command words in QTEs to silence it.

idle_animation.description: Coils shift in slow figure-eights, tongue tasting the air, scales flat gray.

phases.transformation: A road-long serpent, coiled tight around the fallen tree.
It rears up taller than the trees, coils around the whole road; voice gets louder.

defeat_animation.description: Silenced, it shrinks, coils loosen, slides away into the leaves, bite fades.

boss.canon: bible boss #12 (Road to the garden, Act IV, Heart 4,500, 2 phases; P2 player is Sethra, word-choice QTEs)

zeref_moment: Zeref sits on Sethra's lap the whole way after the bite.

title: Gate of Garden

scene_beats.setting: Gate of an ancient garden, walls of living vines. A Tree of Mercy beyond, dripping golden oil.
scene_beats.action: Sethra kneels at the gate and puts dust on her head.

scene_beats.setting: A tall guardian of the garden appears, robed in leaves, face kind and very still.
scene_beats.action: The Garden Guardian gives the answer.

scene_beats.setting: Close-up: Sethra's hands holding a small branch and a pouch of spices.
scene_beats.action: Gift: a small branch and spices: nard, crocus, calaminth, cinnamon.

zeref_moment: Zeref sniffs the spices and sneezes a single star.

title: Six Days

scene_beats.setting: Thorne's house over six days. Tea steam, a branch planted in a pot, Thorne smiling in his chair.
scene_beats.action: Six quiet optional days: tea, plant the branch, listen to his stories.

scene_beats.setting: Tablet Stone by the hearth. Sethra carves; her hand shakes. Arin's hand over hers.
scene_beats.action: Tablet tutorial: Stone and Earth, so his life survives any flood or fire.

scene_beats.setting: The empty room. The chair. The camera stays a beat too long. Then the sun, moon, stars go dark.
scene_beats.action: Thorne dies, quietly, off-screen. Mote climbs onto the empty chair and stays.

zeref_moment: Zeref climbs up next to Mote on the empty chair. Stays too.
